books.title: Sahih al-Bukhari
books.author: Imam Muhammad ibn Ismail al-Bukhari
books.description: One of the six major hadith collections in Sunni Islam, compiled by Imam al-Bukhari. It contains over 7,000 hadith with full chains of narration.

books.title: Jami at-Tirmidhi
books.author: Imam Abu Isa Muhammad at-Tirmidhi
books.description: One of the six major hadith collections, compiled by Imam at-Tirmidhi. Known for grading hadith and noting scholarly differences of opinion.

books.title: Sahih Muslim
books.author: Imam Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj
books.description: The second most authentic hadith collection after Sahih al-Bukhari, compiled by Imam Muslim.

books.title: Sunan Abu Dawud
books.author: Imam Abu Dawud as-Sijistani
books.description: One of the six major hadith collections, focusing on legal hadith and rulings.

books.title: Sunan an-Nasa'i
books.author: Imam Ahmad an-Nasa'i
books.description: One of the six major hadith collections, known for its strict criteria in accepting narrators.

books.title: Sunan Ibn Majah
books.author: Imam Muhammad ibn Yazid Ibn Majah
books.description: The sixth of the major hadith collections, compiled by Imam Ibn Majah.
